next.reason: §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR8 as amended by X3.23b-1993: 'When the CHARACTERS phrase is used, literal-3 or the size of the data item referenced by identifier-5 must be one character in length.' The amendment struck literal-2 and identifier-4 from the 1985 print ('literal-2, literal-3, or the size of the data item referenced by identifier-4, identifier-5'), so only the replacing operand is limited. §2023:14.9.22.3 SR7 keeps the literal half as a syntax rule: 'When the CHARACTERS phrase is specified, literal-3 shall be one character in length.' The identifier half moved to §2023:14.9.22.4 GR15: 'the data item referenced by identifier-5 shall be one character in length. If it is not, the EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE exception condition is set to exist and the results of the execution of the INSPECT statement are undefined.' A 1985 refusal of a longer identifier-5 became an exception condition with an undefined result.
